text: Derive-synthesis iteration 0 brief: host notes and the own-contribution-line reminder; named the accepted research and study review results as read-only context, with standing advisory STU-021 not to be inherited and STU-017/019 research rows superseded by the study; listed the corrections the reviews made during the study (distinct figures of Ambrose and Augustine; the Collect's petition; Gregory's whirlwind and six sections; the two-gifts link as the study's inference; Durandus copying Sicard; the one-clause rule for commentators' other Masses) and the defect classes earlier Claude concise studies failed on, including the disclaimer-plus-stock-label pattern. No content conclusion beyond the reviews' findings.
